name: Docker
description: Containers of the Docker Engine grouped by Compose project: start, stop, restart and remove them, compose up, down and pull, and terminal tabs for their logs and a shell.

host.title: Engine address
host.description: unix:///path/docker.sock, tcp://host:2376 or https://host:2376. Empty finds the engine like the docker CLI: the current docker context, then the default sockets (Docker Desktop, Colima, OrbStack, Rancher Desktop). Plain tcp:// without TLS works but is flagged in the panel.

logTailLines.title: Log lines at the start
logTailLines.description: How many past lines a container's log tab shows before it follows new output.
